description_en: Queries all custom settings (such as trace sampling settings and agent switches) of an application in Application Monitoring. This operation applies only to applications that use Application Monitoring, not to applications that use Managed Service for OpenTelemetry
description_zh: 查询应用监控中，某个应用的全部自定义设置（如调用链采样设置、Agent开关等）。此接口仅适用于接入应用监控的应用，不适用于接入可观测链路 OpenTelemetry 版的应用
name: GetTraceAppConfig

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

You can obtain the Pid by using one of the following methods:

API: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2588008.html.

Console: In the Application Real-Time Monitoring Service (ARMS) console, choose Application Monitoring > Applications and click the name of the target application. The URL in the browser address bar contains the Pid of the application in the format of pid=xxx. Because the browser encodes the URL, you must modify the Pid. For example, if the Pid in the URL is xxx%4074xxx, replace %40 with @. The actual Pid is xxx@74xxx.


<notice>

The method of obtaining the Pid from the console applies only to applications that use Application Monitoring, not to applications that use Managed Service for OpenTelemetry.

The GetTraceAppConfig operation described in this topic supports querying custom settings only for applications that use Application Monitoring.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

您可以通过以下两种方法获取Pid：

API：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2588008.html。

控制台：在ARMS控制台的应用监控>应用列表页面单击目标应用名称。此时浏览器地址栏中的URL即包含应用的Pid，格式为pid=xxx。由于浏览器进行了编码，因此需要对Pid稍作修改。例如，如果URL中包含的Pid为xxx%4074xxx，则需要将%40替换为@，即：xxx@74xxx。


<notice>

通过控制台获取Pid的方法，仅适用于接入应用监控的应用，不适用于接入可观测链路 OpenTelemetry 版的应用。

本文档所描述的接口GetTraceAppConfig，也仅支持查询接入应用监控的应用的自定义设置。

</notice>
parameters.name: pid

Data.description_en: The custom configuration of the application. The value is a JSON string. For the meaning of each configuration item, see Supplementary description of response elements
Data.description_zh: 应用的自定义配置，格式为一个JSON字符串，每个配置的含义见返回参数补充说明

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the query was successful
